source_problem: The same post-state Amount is constrained independently for each OrderEntry against the operation-entry Amount. Entries with different subtotals create incompatible equalities; equal subtotals do not accumulate.
approved_postconditions: The final amount equals the operation-entry amount plus the sum of the subtotal of every associated OrderEntry.
Distinct OrderEntry objects with equal subtotals contribute separately.
When there are no entries, the amount remains equal to its operation-entry value.
correction_scope: Replace conflicting per-entry final-amount equalities with one duplicate-preserving aggregate over the associated entries. Preserve the current-order guard, REQUESTED status and Boolean success result.
